app.footer: Duplicate detection is a clean-room implementation; the design approach references BookOrbit (AGPL-3.0), with rules and weights redone for MyBooks.
app.title: Duplicate Finder
bench.hint: Deleting a source record also loses its favorites, reading status, progress, rating and booklists. Confirm which copy to keep first — the tool cannot read that data, so this call is yours.
bench.pickNoneHint: Nothing selected yet: unchecked copies are left untouched
bench.selectedCount: {n} selected to merge into the kept copy (unchecked copies stay as they are)
del.title: Delete 《{title}》?
del.warn: This also removes the favorites, reading status, progress, duration, rating, review and booklist membership recorded on this copy — none of it moves to the other copies in the group.
diff.allSame: Both copies have identical metadata and record attributes
handled.title: Handled in this session
keep.multiProtected: Several copies carry reading data — the tool cannot decide
list.emptyFiltered: No groups match the current filter
list.groupTitle: {n} copies may be the same book
plan.applied: Merged: {m} formats copied, {d} duplicate records deleted
plan.appliedKept: Merged: {m} formats copied, {d} duplicate records deleted; {k} left unchecked and untouched
plan.appliedPartial: Merged: {m} formats copied, {d} duplicates deleted; {f} failed (see "Handled in this session")
plan.deleteSourceCount: Delete the {n} selected records after merging
plan.deleteSourceOff: Unchecked: formats are merged over only — both records stay (same-name copies are still discarded and disk usage does not drop).
plan.failed: Could not build the merge preview
plan.title: Merge preview
plan.trashHint: Deleted books go to the library recycle bin (Admin → Recycle bin can restore them); but this copy's favorites, reading status, progress, rating, review and booklist membership are gone for good.
plan.userDataWarn: Of the records selected for deletion, {n} carry your rating/tags/summary: {titles}
plan.warnDrop: Same-name formats are not copied: the source copy of those files is discarded and the kept copy wins.
plan.warnMigrate: Favorites, reading status, progress, ratings and booklists of the source record are **deleted with it** — they are not migrated to the keeper.
reason.sameBook: source and keeper are the same book
reason.sourceMissing: this book is no longer in the library
reason.targetMissing: the keeper is no longer in the library
scope.restoreFailed: Could not read the previous result
scope.thresholdHint: Higher is stricter (nearly identical only); lower catches retitled duplicates but also more false positives. 85 is the default, and the value actually used is shown in the report so you can tune it for your own library.
scope.title: Scope
summary.title: Result
